qrHint: Point a phone camera at it, or scan it in {app} on another device, such as a TV.
qrNote: The code carries your subscription link — keep it to yourself.
rotateHint: Replace it: the old one stops working at once, and you will need to add the new one on every device. WireGuard configs are not affected.
rotatedHint: Every app is disconnected — add the new link on each of your devices. WireGuard configs work as before.
setupLink: No app yet? How to install it →
rotateConfirmBody: The current link stops working immediately. Every device connected through an app (INCY or another one) is removed from the list and disconnected — you will need to add the new link on each of them. WireGuard configs are not affected.
unavailable: Could not load your subscription link. Check your connection and try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy — select the link and copy it by hand.
rotateTitle: Did the link get into the wrong hands?
openHint: The subscription is added by itself, so you can skip step two. If the app did not open, the link is already copied — paste it as shown below.

steps.connectHint: Pick a country and connect. If it does not connect, try another option for the same country — VLESS instead of Hysteria2.

paste.incy: Open INCY, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard — the subscription arrives with every server.
paste.hiddify: Open Hiddify, tap “+” (new profile) and choose “Add from clipboard”.
paste.v2rayng: Open v2rayNG, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard. Then tap “Update subscription” in the ⋮ menu to load the servers.
paste.streisand: Open Streisand, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard — the link is added as a subscription.
paste.nekobox: Open NekoBox, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard — the link is added as a subscription.
paste.clashMeta: Open Clash Meta, go to Profiles, tap “+” → URL, paste the link and save. Then select that profile.
